injury_policy: Exact GSIS ID and current team required; official OUT excluded; questionable/doubtful and practice LIMITED/DNP flagged separately. No game designation can mean report not yet published. Weekly ACT is roster membership only, never game-day clearance. Official inactives are unverified.
